output.explanation: Expanded ownership-core, the sole supplied diagram, into a central application/runtime/session ownership tree and two deeper peripherals: session-io and session-rendering. No diagrams were left unchanged. Surface-owned controllers remain siblings of the objects they borrow; cross-diagram edges preserve terminal, mutex, mailbox, device and font relationships. Verified against the pinned checkout without changing it. Corrections: focused_surface references Core Surface, not the runtime wrapper; App.deinit directly invokes runtime deinit, which is a no-op for the GTK adapter; full Surface teardown frees Inspector after workers join without explicitly clearing its shared pointer. GPU cleanup is distinguished from Renderer.deinit.

diagrams.ascii:
Ghostty session ownership -- bootstrap/GUI host lifetime boundary
|
|-- CoreApp: created by main() or embedded C API; destroyed at shutdown
|   |   [src/main_ghostty.zig:100-109; src/apprt/embedded.zig:1714-1748]
|   |-- Bookkeeping: list storage, mailbox, focus, conditional config,
|   |   notification throttling and first-surface flag [src/App.zig:25-74]
|   |   |-- surfaces[] -> borrowed runtime surface holders below
|   |   |-- focused_surface -> borrowed Core Surface; validate with hasSurface
|   |   `-- tick drains mailbox; deleteSurface unregisters, never frees objects
|   |       [src/App.zig:159-165,204-240]
|   |-- font_grid_set: SharedGridSet [src/font/SharedGridSet.zig:36-78]
|   |   |-- Owns library, lazy discovery and keyed reference-counted SharedGrids
|   |   `-- ref creates/reuses; deref frees grid/key at zero; App requires zero
|   |       live entries on shutdown [src/font/SharedGridSet.zig:89-96,413-430]
|   |-- device: optional shared graphics device; first Surface.init creates it
|   |   `-- Retained across session closures; freed after surface renderers
|   |       [src/Surface.zig:564-570; src/App.zig:145-150]
|   `-- deinit invokes each registered runtime surface's deinit, frees list,
|       then fonts/device; this does NOT own/free runtime wrapper allocations.
|       GTK adapter deinit is a no-op: widget finalization does the real work.
|       [src/App.zig:136-156; src/apprt/gtk/Surface.zig:15-17]
|
|-- Runtime application: apprt.App / GTK Application
|   |-- Embedded: owns cloned Config, lazy keymap and host callback options;
|   |   terminate frees config/keymap [src/apprt/embedded.zig:139-174]
|   |-- GTK: retains Config and platform/UI resources; dispose and deinit
|   |   (also called by finalize) release them [src/apprt/gtk/class/application.zig:453-481,1554-1586]
|   `-- core_app -> CoreApp; config updates arrive here, not a second font/device owner
|
`-- Runtime surface holders: one GUI widget / host handle per session
    |-- Embedded wrapper owns title and inspector wrapper; newSurface allocates;
    |   closeSurface deinitializes/frees [src/apprt/embedded.zig:278-294,447-504,634-648]
    |-- GTK widget retains allocated core_surface; finalize unregisters,
    |   deinitializes and destroys it [src/apprt/gtk/class/surface.zig:1963-1980,3557-3624]
    |-- Registration -> CoreApp.surfaces (not allocation ownership)
    `-- Core Surface: by value in embedded wrapper; heap allocation in GTK
        |   init creates session and starts workers; close asks runtime to destroy
        |   [src/Surface.zig:477-765,883-888]
        |-- config: owned DerivedConfig; replaced on reload, freed on deinit
        |   `-- No retained caller Config [src/Surface.zig:140-144,506-508,1804-1848,876]
        |-- keyboard: queued sequence writes and active table stack
        |   |-- Reload drops sequences/tables; deinit frees requests and storage
        |   `-- Binding/table references -> this Surface.config
        |       [src/Surface.zig:279-300,863-867,1835-1848]
        |-- mouse: buttons, scroll/link tracking and selection gesture
        |   `-- Gesture pins -> io.terminal; released before terminal destruction
        |       [src/Surface.zig:232-277,855]
        |-- Session values: size, focus, visibility, readonly, child-exit flag,
        |   conditional config and command timing [src/Surface.zig:103-187]
        |-- Font lease: font_grid_key -> CoreApp.font_grid_set
        |   `-- Size/config change acquires new grid, hands old-key release to
        |       renderer mailbox; deinit drops final lease [src/Surface.zig:530-534,2536-2572,871]
        |-- io: Termio -- owns terminal model, parser and subprocess [IO detail]
        |-- io_thread + io_thr -- owns IO execution lifetime [IO detail]
        |-- renderer_state -- shared synchronization/presentation data [render detail]
        |   `-- terminal -> io.terminal; inspector -> optional Inspector below
        |-- renderer -- per-surface CPU/GPU resources [render detail]
        |   `-- Borrows CoreApp.device and font grid through this Surface's lease
        |-- renderer_thread + renderer_thr -- rendering execution [render detail]
        |   `-- Borrows renderer / renderer_state / runtime surface, not their owner
        |-- search: optional Search; first nonempty query creates it
        |   |-- state: owns loop, mailbox, wake/stop handles, refresh timer,
        |   |   search/match data and notification progress
        |   |-- thread: stopped/joined before state deinit; empty query,
        |   |   end_search or Surface.deinit releases it
        |   `-- Borrows io.terminal and renderer_state.mutex; releases terminal-linked
        |       search data under that lock; events feed renderer highlights
        |       [src/Surface.zig:210-227,5080-5146; src/terminal/search/Thread.zig:46-132]
        |-- inspector: optional heap Inspector; owns GUI/data and mouse state
        |   `-- Deactivation clears renderer_state.inspector under mutex before free;
        |       full Surface teardown frees after workers join (no explicit clear)
        |       [src/Surface.zig:929-955,972-991,858-861; src/inspector/Inspector.zig:19-22,64-70]
        |-- app / rt_app / rt_surface -> enclosing application/runtime holders
        `-- Teardown: stop/join search, renderer, then IO; only then release state.
            Renderer.deinit stops display-link callbacks before renderer_thread.deinit;
            gesture pins die before io; font lease, preedit/mutex and config last.
            [src/Surface.zig:829-880]

Surface IO detail -- owned branches of the same Core Surface
|
|-- io: termio.Termio [src/Surface.zig:664-727]
|   |   Init accepts backend/config/mailbox ownership; deinit runs after workers stop
|   |-- terminal: Terminal -- authoritative mutable model
|   |   |-- screens: ScreenSet [src/terminal/ScreenSet.zig:24-112]
|   |   |   |-- all: owns primary Screen immediately; alternate allocated lazily
|   |   |   |   `-- Each Screen [src/terminal/Screen.zig:45-87,361-367]
|   |   |   |       |-- pages: PageList holding active rows and scrollback
|   |   |   |       |-- Cursor/saved cursor, tracked selection and charset
|   |   |   |       |-- Kitty keyboard state and Kitty image storage
|   |   |   |       `-- VT output/resize mutate; deinit frees cursor/pages/images
|   |   |   `-- active -> one owned Screen; switchTo only changes reference;
|   |   |       remove frees non-primary screen, deinit frees all initialized screens
|   |   `-- Modes, palette, tab stops, title, cwd, glyph glossary, optional drag/drop
|   |       state; Terminal.deinit releases storage [src/terminal/Terminal.zig:49-106,395-405]
|   |-- terminal_stream: persistent VT parser and StreamHandler
|   |   |-- processOutput parses/mutates terminal under renderer_state.mutex
|   |   `-- Handler -> this terminal/config/mailbox/size and borrowed message routes;
|   |       stream deinit releases parser state [src/termio/Termio.zig:313-375,705-765]
|   |-- config: owned derived copy; reload replaces it under shared mutex
|   |-- mailbox: owns queued IO messages and SPSC wakeup resources
|   |-- thread_enter_state: optional arena-backed startup input; destroyed after
|   |   entry attempt, or on deinit if unused [src/termio/Termio.zig:354-385,466-523]
|   |-- backend.exec.subprocess: launch data and process/PTY lifetime
|   |   |-- Owns arguments, cwd/environment; init prepares, threadEnter launches
|   |   |-- PTY and process: opened/started on launch; success releases environment
|   |   |   and POSIX parent's slave FD [src/termio/Exec.zig:594-624,897-941]
|   |   `-- threadExit stops subprocess before reader shutdown; backend deinit
|   |       closes PTY/frees launch data [src/termio/Exec.zig:196-238,887-893]
|   |-- renderer_state -> sibling Surface.renderer_state (terminal-access mutex)
|   |-- renderer_wakeup / renderer_mailbox -> sibling renderer_thread handles
|   `-- surface_mailbox -> Surface + CoreApp mailbox + runtime wakeup route
|       [src/termio/Termio.zig:46-56,313-351]
|
`-- io_thread + io_thr: Surface-owned controller and spawned OS thread
    |-- io_thread: event loop, stop handle, selection-scroll, resize-coalescing
    |   and synchronized-output timers; deinit only after join
    |   [src/termio/Thread.zig:44-136]
    |-- io_thr execution: stable stack-owned CallbackData.data = Termio.ThreadData
    |   |   threadEnter initializes; deferred threadExit runs before data.deinit
    |   |   [src/termio/Thread.zig:259-269]
    |   `-- backend.exec runtime data [src/termio/Exec.zig:493-566]
    |       |-- Process watcher, write stream, write queue/pool and termios timer
    |       |-- Reader thread and quit-pipe write end
    |       |   `-- POSIX reader execution owns Pipeline, optional idle pipe,
    |       |       quit-pipe read end and gather-thread lifetime
    |       |       |-- Gather fills bounded rotating buffers; reader parses batches
    |       |       `-- Reader joins gather before releasing local resources
    |       |           [src/termio/Exec.zig:1270-1304,1412-1491]
    |       `-- Exit order: stop subprocess, signal quit, join reader, then release
    |           watcher/stream/pool/timer/pipe [src/termio/Exec.zig:196-238,549-566]
    `-- io / terminal / mailbox -> Surface.io; no duplicate terminal ownership

Surface rendering detail -- owned branches of the same Core Surface
|
|-- renderer_state: shared State [src/renderer/State.zig:13-46]
|   |-- mutex allocation, preedit codepoints, mouse presentation values,
|   |   demand/handoff counters; Surface replaces preedit and frees it/mutex
|   |   after worker joins [src/Surface.zig:590-593,2676-2738,873-875]
|   |-- terminal -> Surface.io.terminal; mutex coordinates IO, UI, render and search
|   `-- inspector -> Surface.inspector; pointer cleared on live deactivation
|
|-- renderer: per-surface Renderer [src/renderer/generic.zig:112-290,712-873]
|   |-- CPU state: DerivedConfig, draw mutex, RenderState snapshot, cells, uniforms,
|   |   shaper/cache, search-highlight message arenas and optional overlay
|   |   `-- Frame updates mutate copies; Renderer.deinit releases CPU state;
|   |       search selections reference terminal pages and must be validated
|   |-- GPU state: graphics API wrapper, swap chain/frame resources, shaders,
|   |   Kitty images and optional background image
|   |   |-- releaseGpuResources waits for in-flight frames before swap-chain free;
|   |   |   frees shaders when unrealized [src/renderer/generic.zig:1244-1255]
|   |   `-- threadExit marks unrealized and releases GPU resources/images;
|   |       Renderer.deinit is not the GPU shutdown [src/renderer/generic.zig:841-873,914-943]
|   |-- latest_frame: retains latest exported frame; replacement releases old;
|   |   takeFrame transfers ownership to runtime consumer; deinit releases retained
|   |   frame [src/renderer/generic.zig:124-131,851,1058-1071]
|   |-- display_link: optional, lazily created; closed by Renderer.deinit
|   |   `-- Callback -> renderer_thread.draw_now; must stop before handle is freed
|   |       [src/renderer/generic.zig:853-862,1272-1287]
|   |-- Graphics device -> CoreApp.device; borrowed until renderer is gone
|   |-- font_grid -> CoreApp.font_grid_set; kept alive through Surface font lease
|   `-- surface_mailbox -> runtime/CoreApp route; no ownership of host
|
`-- renderer_thread + renderer_thr: Surface-owned scheduler and execution
    |-- renderer_thread [src/renderer/Thread.zig:30-85,177-189]
    |   |-- Event loop; mailbox; wake/stop/draw_now handles
    |   |-- Animation/cursor timers, compression scheduling and derived config
    |   |-- Mailbox messages update scheduling, renderer config and font grid
    |   |   `-- Font-grid handoff installs new grid then derefs old key
    |   |       [src/renderer/Thread.zig:397-400]
    |   `-- renderer / state / surface -> sibling Renderer / State / runtime holder
    |-- renderer_thr: spawned by Surface; stop/join before scheduler deinit
    `-- Teardown dependency: Renderer.deinit closes display_link before scheduler
        handles are released [src/Surface.zig:829-857]
